title: Embed match onboarding visual tour and artifacts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a visual-first onboarding tour and a set of product screenshots for the embedding + rerank flow. The deliverables will be used across the docs quickstart, in-console help, and a short in-app guided tour. Focus: a clear pipeline diagram that shows vector indexing, similarity search, reranker invocation, and final ranked output; sample outputs with token highlights; and compact annotated screenshots for the Console onboarding card.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Pipeline diagram (SVG) that can be resized for docs and in-console with annotated steps: ingest -> embed -> index -> search -> rerank -> results
A2: Three sample output cards showing: (a) raw vector similarity results, (b) reranker scores + highlighted rationale, (c) final ranked list with confidence indicators
A3: Eight console screenshots (desktop + mobile) annotated for accessibility copy and callouts
A4: Exported asset pack (SVG, PNG @2x, Figma file link) uploaded to Drive and linked in this ticket
A5: Design review approved by PM and Engineering and a small UX copy pass completed
